plainText:
Hiroshi Tsuchida (Japanese: 土田大 Tsuchida Hiroshi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Tsuchida was born on February 8, 1954, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided the voice of during . He then voiced Eusine in Pokémon Generations. In addition to voice acting roles, Tezuka is a live-action actor and has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
